messages:
Asha (CS): FYI, AcornHealth asked us to onboard a domain-specific summarizer for clinical notes. They insist on private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) with HSM-managed keys, strict no-persistent-user-logs, and must pass our safety eval before renewal. Renewal in ~6w — high risk if delayed. Can we scope timeline and owners?
Liam (Infra): Noted. Private + HSM doable. Need ticket for VPC peering, vault/KMS creds, and clarification on GPU profile. They mentioned a 7B variant — any latency SLO?
Devon (ML): We can run safety + quality evals. Ask them for an anonymized sample of notes and expected summary length distribution. Also need a small holdout with PHI examples redacted so we can verify redaction.
Renee (PM): Heads-up: our infra team is loaded this sprint. Is there an MVP path (e.g., dedicated vs private) that satisfies "no egress"? Customer is strict about data residency.
Asha (CS): They require zero-evidence-of-e2e-telemetry to third parties. Private/VPC only. They want canary in prod within 2 weeks of artifact handoff.
Onboard Bot: New onboarding created · CS-7981 · Asha (CS)
Liam (Infra): If Eng-ML delivers a compiled model artifact + quantization profile by EOD Fri we can aim for a 2-week canary. Need access method: S3 presigned or customer bundle. Also need HSM vendor details (they use Thales).
Devon (ML): Proposed eval plan: safety/regression on ~5k prompt/target pairs, hallucination threshold <2% (domain-specific), PHI redaction tests, and perf targets p50 <250ms for 512-token history. I'll stand up the eval harness. Can we get the prompt suite?
Asha (CS): I'll collect a sanitized prompt set and ask legal for a signed assurance about redaction. Scheduling enablement with their ML infra lead Wed 10:00 PT.
Renee (PM): Flagging renewal owner Susan (AM) — if canary misses SLA, escalate to exec sponsor. I'll update CRM with "at-risk" tag.
Devon (ML): For PHI checks we'll run both heuristic regex tests and a model-based detector. Example redaction config I plan to use:
```yaml
redaction:
  enabled: true
  patterns:
    - ssn

    - medical_record_number
  strategy: deterministic-mask
  audit_mode: false
```
Liam (Infra): Also need a privacy-preserving logging policy. Recommend: disable raw input persistence, only emit aggregated perf metrics and error counters. I'll draft ops PR.
Asha (CS): Action items:
- Asha: collect prompt set + confirm HSM contact + get signed no-logging clause
- Devon: finalize eval plan + pass/fail criteria + run first pass on sample
- Liam: open infra ticket for VPC/HSM + draft log policy
- Renee: update CRM renewal risk + coordinate enablement schedule
I'll send a brief to Susan after enablement.
Devon (ML): One more rec: model variant = gpt-7b-q4_0 (quantized) with tuned KV-cache params. Will validate quality/latency tradeoffs on our bench.
Renee (PM): If we get eval green by next Tue we can make the canary window before the renewal.
Onboard Bot: Reminder scheduled · Enablement session Wed 10:00 PT · CS-7981
Asha (CS): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Liam (Infra): Opening infra ticket CS-7981-IR now and assigning @Devon
Devon (ML): Got it, will prioritize the eval runs and post preliminary results here.
Renee (PM): Copy — I'll prepare the renewal note and include the risk mitigation plan.
